question.text: Which of the following is included in the cover page of a Scheme Information Document (SID)?

answer.text: The name of the scheme, the type/category of scheme, and the clause that SEBI has not approved or recommended the units and has not certified the SID's accuracy or adequacy
Detailed asset allocation pattern and investment strategy of the scheme
Complete list of current portfolio holdings with their market values
Historical NAV data and performance comparison with benchmark

explanation.text: The Logic: The cover page of the SID carries essential identification information such as scheme name, type/category, NFO dates, date of SID, and fund/AMC/trustee details. It also includes the standard clause that SEBI has not approved or recommended the units and has not certified the accuracy or adequacy of the SID. The Trap: Asset allocation and investment strategy are internal sections of the SID, not cover-page items. Portfolio holdings sit in Fact Sheets, and historical performance is a separate section within the SID rather than on the cover page. Note: Use the exact source wording: SEBI has not approved or recommended the units and has not certified the SID's accuracy or adequacy.
